name: Brands Hatch Indy
notes: Indy circuit as in 1991 (clockwise): Brabham Straight, Paddock Hill Bend, Druids, Graham Hill Bend, Cooper Straight, Surtees, Clearways, Clark Curve. Line from race-tracks indy@1976. Until 2026-11-17 the pack borrowed the DTM 2013 track (dtm-era4); the race values are the ones it shipped with, without its DRS zone. BTCC 1991 race laps 36 (Autosport).
